status: Frozen observational companion; no fitted predictor or trading filter
decisionTime: Original signal confirmation +15 minutes, for accepted and nonaccepted signals, including A already stopped and portfolio-busy signals.
primaryUniverse: All parent calendar-eligible signals with complete feature/target windows, timely parent signal, acceptance update and feature capture each within 90 seconds of their own event. Late and missing records reported separately.

features.agreement: with_BOS / against_BOS / disagree / zero, using signs of the two normalized momenta
features.efficiency60: absolute 60m net close movement / sum of 12 absolute 5m close movements; zero denominator is missing
features.costToATR: scenario (spread + 2 adverse market slippages + roundtrip commission) / preBOS_ATR. Market-roundtrip reference, not actual realized TP-limit fees.
features.descriptive240: Recorded only if full 49-close window exists; not a primary fitted predictor

challengerAdds: agreement category with disagree as reference
redundancy: Fixed central/stress cost-to-ATR is a scalar multiple of inversePriorATR. Record for execution diagnostics; omit from added-information test. Acceptance is deterministic given signedDistanceATR but supplies a prespecified threshold basis in both models.

targets.primary: signed reference open_U to close_(T+120m) / preBOS_ATR, exactly 105 one-minute bars
targets.secondary: MFE/MAE and reference +/-1 preBOS ATR first-hit; ambiguous minute is separate. No trading instruction.
targets.policy: B net R stays in the parent ledger with its own entry+120m horizon; do not equate it with common-horizon price return.

analysis.status: Specified algorithm; analysis executor and trained coefficients not yet created
analysis.trainingRule: Use only training decisions with matured target ending no later than trainingEnd. Complete four UTC weeks represented.
analysis.evaluationRule: Two-hour embargo; score target windows ending no later than evaluationEnd. No moving endpoints based on results.
analysis.model: Two ridge linear regressions, sum of squared training residuals + 1*sum squared coefficients; intercept unpenalized. Training-only numeric centering/scaling; fixed categorical levels.
analysis.minimum: At least 50 complete timely training and 50 evaluation signals, with four UTC weeks each represented. Otherwise incomplete/inconclusive; these minima do not guarantee power.
analysis.primaryMetric: Baseline MSE minus challenger MSE on identical evaluation observations; MAE is a guardrail.
analysis.uncertainty: 4000 paired calendar-week bootstrap resamples of evaluation errors; 95% percentile interval. Four evaluation weeks limits precision. Report both chronological evaluation halves without tuning.
analysis.evidentiaryGate: Positive MSE improvement lower bound, no worse MAE overall, positive MSE difference in both chronological halves. Exploratory predictive support only; no profitability or trading promotion claim.
analysis.secondary: Accepted-only subgroup and first-hit summaries are descriptive. No threshold search or extra feature models.
analysis.predictionTiming: Prespecified chronological evaluation on prospectively captured features. Any later reconstruction is labeled offline prediction, not contemporaneously issued forecast.
analysis.historical: All prior years previously examined; any historical fits are exploratory and separate.

collection: Separate append-only feature and label ledgers; no scheduler installed. On-demand chain verifies both packages then runs ACCEPT followed by STATE.
boundary: If the parent boundary changes, establish a separately versioned companion before collection. Current first capture checks for existing parent signals only.
executionEvidence: Twelve Data proxy prices. No Bybit quotes or observed broker fills are supplied by this companion.
